assetType: reusable 16x16 tile atlas for a monochrome 2D RPG
primaryRequest: Create one grayscale 8-column by 8-row atlas of 64 distinct, reusable top-down overworld tiles. Keep a consistent cell scale and place one tile family in each row. Make the tile silhouettes and values read clearly when each cell is reduced to 16x16 pixels.
style: Hand-inked field-guide pixel art with clear contours, grouped shadow marks, graphic linework and restrained internal texture.
layout: Row 1: grass variants, flowers, gravel, stone, cultivated earth, pavement.
Row 2: connected horizontal, vertical, corner, T-junction and cross paths.
Row 3: tree canopy pieces, shrubs, fallen log, flowers and stump.
Row 4: cave wall edges, side wall, boulder, crystal, stalagmite and entrance.
Row 5: cottage roof and wall pieces, door/window, fence and garden bed.
Row 6: shop fronts, doorway, display window, curb and street lamp.
Row 7: water, shoreline segments, bank edges, bridges and stepping stones.
Row 8: well, signpost, crate, bench, vegetable patch, flowerpot, boulder and geode.
constraints: Each cell is an independent tile image on an exact 8x8 grid.
Use no text, labels, palette swatches, UI, characters or watermarks.
Do not bake a dither pattern into the source.
Keep object silhouettes within their cells so the atlas can be sliced and reused.
Do not use existing spike artwork as a visual reference.
